meta.title: 6 things worth letting go of this year

autumn trees shedding leaves landscape painting
J. M. W. Turner calm open water painting

beats.text: Six things worth finally letting go of.
One. The need to be right. Being right rarely matters as much as being at peace.
Two. Grudges. They're a weight only you carry, for someone who isn't holding it with you.
Three. The opinions of people you will never see again.
Four. Comparing your chapter one to somebody else's chapter twenty.
Five. Waiting for permission. The people you're waiting on are busy waiting too.
Six. The version of your life that was never actually going to happen. Grieve it, then live this one.
You don't rise by carrying more. Sometimes you rise by setting things down.

source_note: Which one are you ready to drop?
